_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Individually sourced historical Indonesian and Philippine drug-case profiles. Case organizations are proceedings, not independent long-lived cartel claims. Status is bound to cited judgments/reports, with later outcomes stated where verified. All person map evidence is historical country-level conduct; no transit-country inference, precise/live locations, operational route detail, inferred personal edges, or portraits.
